class.name: ItemAnimator
class.brief_description: Base class for animating item add / remove / move / change.
class.description:
ItemAnimator is the port of [i]RecyclerView.ItemAnimator[/i]. After an incremental update the RecyclerView runs a two-pass layout (recording before/after rects) and dispatches the appropriate [code]_animate_*[/code] callback for every affected holder. The default implementation is [b]DefaultItemAnimator[/b]; subclass this class to drive your own tweens instead.
Override one or more of [method _animate_add], [method _animate_remove], [method _animate_move] and [method _animate_change], and remember to release the holder (e.g. via [method RecyclerView.recycle_view]) once your animation finishes so it can be recycled.

method.name: _animate_add
method.description: Called for a newly added item. [code]from[/code] / [code]to[/code] are the pre/post layout rects.

method.name: _animate_change
method.description: Called when an item's content changes.

method.name: _animate_move
method.description: Called when an item moves from one position to another.

method.name: is_animating
method.description: Returns whether the holder is currently animating.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns whether any animation is still running.

method.name: mark_animating
method.description: Marks a holder as animating (adds it to the animating list).

method.name: unmark_animating
method.description: Removes a holder from the animating list.
